I've gathered vendor-documented pricing and feature data. Here's the comparison and recommendation.

## What I verified (vendor sites, Sept 5, 2026, list prices, taxes/promos excluded)

| Product | Entry | Mid | Top | Users |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **QuickBooks Online CA** | EasyStart $30 CAD/mo | Plus $110 | Advanced $220 | 1 / 5 / 25 |
| **Xero CA** | Starter $25 CAD/mo | Standard $60 | Premium $80 | Unlimited, all tiers |
| **Zoho Books CA** | Free C$0 | Standard C$15/mo (annual) | Prof. C$30 / Premium C$40 | 1+acct / 3 / 5 / 10 |
| **Sage Accounting CA** | Start $23 CAD/mo | Standard $50 | Plus $72 | tiered |
| **Wave** | Starter US$0 | Pro US$190/yr (~$16/mo) | — | 1 / multi |
| **FreshBooks** | ~$23/mo | ~$43 | ~$70 (+$11/user) | client-count tiers |
| **Odoo** | One App Free (unlimited users) | Standard US$24.90/user/mo | Custom US$49/user/mo | per user |
| **NetSuite / Sage Intacct** | quote-only | — | — | enterprise |

**Scoring against your eight criteria** (5 = strongest):

| | Invoice | Expense | Tax (CA) | Bank feeds | Reporting | Integrations | Export | Migration |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QBO | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 4 | 5 | 4 | 5 |
| Xero | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 5 | 4 | 5 |
| Zoho Books | 5 | 4 | 4 | 3 | 4 | 3 | 5 | 3 |
| Sage | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Wave | 4 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 2 | 1 |
| FreshBooks | 5 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Odoo | 4 | 4 | 3 | 3 | 5 | 4 | 5 | 2 |
| NetSuite/Intacct | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 5 | 5 | 4 | 1 |

Key Canada-specific findings: QuickBooks' own support docs confirm sales tax is a **four-step process — prepare in QBO, then submit to CRA yourself** — no product here auto-files GST/HST. Zoho Books uniquely includes GST/QST returns and T4A/T5018 contractor tracking even on its free tier, but **bank feeds only start at Standard**. Wave's free tier **excludes automatic bank imports** (Pro-only). Xero Starter caps you at 20 invoices/5 bills, but no tier charges per user — material if you add staff or a bookkeeper.

## Recommendation

**Primary: Xero Standard (~$60 CAD/mo).** For a consulting business the deciding factor is unlimited users at a flat price — you, a partner, and your bookkeeper cost the same as one seat. QuickBooks appears to have dropped its Essentials tier in Canada, so the jump from EasyStart ($30, single user, no bills payable) to Plus ($110) is steep for a firm that mostly needs invoicing, GST/HST tracking, and clean reporting. Xero matches QBO on integrations and conversion tooling at roughly half the cost.

**Decision rule that overrides this:** ask your accountant first. QBO's Canadian bookkeeper base is larger; if yours only works in QuickBooks, take QBO Plus — the $50/mo delta is smaller than fighting your accountant's workflow every quarter.

**Low-cost alternative: Zoho Books Standard (C$15/mo annual).** Best feature-per-dollar, with CRA-relevant tax forms and strong export/API. Trade-off is a thinner Canadian advisor ecosystem. Wave Starter is the free floor, but budget for Pro (~US$16/mo) since manual transaction entry defeats the purpose.

**Scalable alternative: Odoo** (free single-app tier, then ~US$25/user/mo) for growth into project profitability and resource planning, with NetSuite or Sage Intacct as the eventual enterprise endpoint. Both demand real implementation effort and have weaker Canadian payroll localization — treat these as a later migration, not a starting point.

Three caveats on the evidence: **FreshBooks' site refused connections from this machine**, so its figures come from a third-party summary and are the one set of numbers you should re-verify — relevant since it's a Toronto company strong at exactly your use case (invoicing and time-billing). Xero's data-export documentation is login-walled, so I rated export from its public pages only. And **bank feed reliability varies by Canadian institution regardless of vendor** — test your actual bank during the free trial before committing, as that's the single most common post-purchase disappointment.
